name: cross-model-review-opus
description: Design and simplification reviewer backed by the Claude Code CLI. Runs with a read-only tool set (Read, Grep, Glob) and no MCP servers.

extensions.description: Requests are a single DataPart matching the skill-request schema; results are an Artifact named '<skill>-result' with a single DataPart matching the skill-result schema.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Per-run random token shared by the orchestrator.

skills.name: Review design (read-only)
skills.description: Design and maintainability review of the change set. Read-only tools only.

skills.name: Review simplification (read-only)
skills.description: Detect unnecessary complexity and propose simpler alternatives. Read-only tools only.
